Continuously monitors the supply to appliances and cuts power if an earth current fault is detected, protecting against the risk of fatal electric shock. When set, retains closed contacts if mains supply is interrupted, with no need to reset after a loss of power. Ideal for appliances such as fridge freezers. Fitted with twin earth, and integrated RCD to prevent electrical current leakage. Front plate is resistant to fading, discolouration and scratches, with inherent anti-microbial properties to reduce bacterial development and inhibit the growth of infectious diseases.
